description: Style-only alignment of the OUI v9 theme to Datadog DRUIDS look and feel. Target ONLY SCSS token files under src/themes/v9/** and component style overrides under src/themes/v9/components/**. Do not modify component TSX/TS source or alter component APIs. DRUIDS foundations reference: colors https://druids.datadoghq.com/foundations/color, spacing https://druids.datadoghq.com/foundations/spacing-and-layout, typography https://druids.datadoghq.com/foundations/typography, elevation https://druids.datadoghq.com/foundations/elevation. Verify visually with src-docs (yarn start) under the 'v9 Light' theme.

userStories.title: Align core gray/neutral palette to DRUIDS light grays
userStories.description: As a designer, I want OUI's neutral shades to mirror DRUIDS gray scale so every surface and divider reads the same. Only edit src/themes/v9/global_styling/variables/_colors.scss.
acceptanceCriteria: Set $ouiColorEmptyShade=#ffffff, $ouiColorLightestShade=#f9fafb (DRUIDS @gray-25--light), $ouiColorLightShade=#e2e5ed (@gray-75--light used as --ui-border), $ouiColorMediumShade=#9da4b9 (@gray-200--light), $ouiColorDarkShade=#6a7287 (@gray-400--light), $ouiColorDarkestShade=#242931 (@gray-800--light), $ouiColorFullShade=#1d1c1f (@neutral--dark as full shade)
Leave SCSS comment tags referencing the DRUIDS variable for each color
Typecheck passes (yarn lint:ts or yarn build)
SCSS compiles successfully (yarn compile-scss or yarn build)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill on v9-light theme that page background and borders match DRUIDS

userStories.title: Align text color tokens to DRUIDS translucent-ink system
userStories.description: As a designer, I want body text, subdued text and disabled text to match DRUIDS' translucent ink so contrast ratios match. Edit only _colors.scss.
acceptanceCriteria: Override $ouiTextColor to rgba(28, 43, 52, 0.98) and $ouiTextSubduedColor to rgba(28, 43, 52, 0.68) (DRUIDS --ui-text / --ui-text-secondary)
$ouiTitleColor remains darker variant of $ouiTextColor and keeps AA contrast on $ouiColorEmptyShade
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill that paragraph, title and subdued copy on the Text page match DRUIDS

userStories.title: Align primary, accent and status colors to DRUIDS interaction scale
userStories.description: As a designer, I want OUI's primary/accent/status colors to match DRUIDS interaction and status tokens so buttons, links and badges share the same hues. Edit only _colors.scss.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify in browser using dev-browser skill that primary buttons, success/danger badges and links adopt DRUIDS hues

userStories.title: Align spacing scale to the DRUIDS 8px grid
userStories.description: As a designer, I want OUI's size tokens to map to DRUIDS xxs(2)/xs(4)/sm(8)/md(16)/lg(24)/xl(32)/xxl(48). Edit only src/themes/v9/global_styling/variables/_size.scss.
acceptanceCriteria: SCSS comments call out the DRUIDS mapping (xxs/xs/sm/md/lg/xl/xxl)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill that page padding on a Panel example equals DRUIDS @spacing-md (16px)

userStories.title: Align typography scale to DRUIDS Basic Typography
userStories.description: As a designer, I want font sizes, line heights and base font to match DRUIDS Basic scale. Edit only src/themes/v9/global_styling/variables/_typography.scss.
acceptanceCriteria: $ouiLineHeight kept so that body text renders at 28px line-height at 13px font (ratio ~2.15) matching @height-md
$ouiFontFamily starts with 'Noto Sans' (already correct) and $ouiCodeFontFamily keeps 'Roboto Mono'
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill that Text and Title examples match DRUIDS scale (13px body, 15/18/23 headings)

userStories.title: Align font weights to DRUIDS 400/600 scale
userStories.description: As a designer, I want non-body weights to resolve to DRUIDS' 400 regular and 600 bold so headings and strong text match. Edit only _typography.scss.
acceptanceCriteria: $ouiFontWeightRegular=400 (unchanged), $ouiFontWeightMedium=400 (alias to regular, DRUIDS has no medium), $ouiFontWeightSemiBold=600, $ouiFontWeightBold=600 (DRUIDS maps bold->600)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill that Title examples render at 600 weight

userStories.title: Align border radii and border colors to DRUIDS
userStories.description: As a designer, I want corners and dividers to match DRUIDS' flat 4px radius and #e2e5ed border. Edit only src/themes/v9/global_styling/variables/_borders.scss.
acceptanceCriteria: $ouiBorderColor derives from $ouiColorLightShade (#e2e5ed) — no direct hex literal
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill that Button, Panel and Card corners render at 4px

userStories.title: Align shadow levels to DRUIDS @shadow-1..6
userStories.description: As a designer, I want elevation shadows to match DRUIDS' six-level stack with base 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1) layer. Edit only src/themes/v9/global_styling/variables/_shadows.scss (and _elevation.scss if needed).
acceptanceCriteria: $ouiShadow1..$ouiShadow6 render exactly as: base + 0 1px 2px / 0 1px 4px / 0 2px 8px / 0 3px 12px / 0 4px 16px / 0 5px 24px at rgba(0,0,0,0.32) in light theme (already defined; verify still accurate after US-001 changes)
Add inline comments mapping each $ouiShadowN to the DRUIDS use case (Button hover, Popover, SidePanel, etc.)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill that Popover and Modal receive DRUIDS-grade shadows

userStories.title: Add DRUIDS --ui-* CSS variables at :root
userStories.description: As a developer, I want DRUIDS semantic CSS variables available so component-level overrides can reference --ui-background, --ui-text, --ui-interaction-primary, etc. Edit only src/themes/v9/global_styling/css_variables/_index.scss (create the file if absent) and _elevation.scss.
acceptanceCriteria: Each variable derives from the SCSS token set in US-001..US-003 (interpolated via #{...})
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill that getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--ui-background') returns #ffffff

userStories.title: Restyle ouiButton to DRUIDS default/primary sizes
userStories.description: As a designer, I want OUI buttons to look like DRUIDS' flat 28px default buttons (md) with 20/28/36 size tiers and primary filled blue. Edit only src/themes/v9/global_styling/variables/_buttons.scss and src/themes/v9/components/_button.scss.
acceptanceCriteria: Default (md) button height = 28px, small = 24px, xs = 20px (aligned to DRUIDS xs=20, md=28, lg=36)
Button horizontal padding 10px md / 6px xs, radius 4px ($ouiBorderRadiusSmall)
Primary filled button: background $ouiColorPrimary (#006bc2), border darker #0953bf, text $ouiColorGhost; hover bg=#0953bf, border unchanged
Default unfilled button: background #ffffff, border 1px solid #c2c8dd, text $ouiTextColor; hover bg=transparentize($ouiTextColor,.95)
Buttons have no box-shadow at rest (flat DRUIDS look); keep $ouiShadow1 only on hover
No changes to button TSX sources
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill that /#/navigation/button matches DRUIDS Button page

userStories.title: Restyle form controls to DRUIDS 28px input
userStories.description: As a designer, I want OUI text inputs, selects and textareas to adopt DRUIDS' 28px flat input (4px radius, #c2c8dd border, white fill). Edit only src/themes/v9/global_styling/variables/_form.scss and, if needed, add src/themes/v9/components/_form.scss override (import it from components/_index.scss).
acceptanceCriteria: Remove the inset box-shadow on focus in favor of a 2px outer ring using $ouiColorPrimary at 25% opacity to mirror DRUIDS focus
No changes to form component TSX sources
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill that /#/forms/form-controls inputs match DRUIDS height, border and focus

userStories.title: Restyle badges and tags to DRUIDS pills
userStories.description: As a designer, I want OUI Badge and BetaBadge to render as DRUIDS tag pills: 4px radius, 13px font, subtle gray bg and dark-blue ink. Edit only src/themes/v9/global_styling/variables/_badge.scss and src/themes/v9/components/_badge.scss / _beta_badge.scss / _notification_badge.scss.
acceptanceCriteria: Status-colored badges use DRUIDS soft backgrounds (tintOrShade(color, 90%, 70%)) with the matching -contrast text color
No changes to badge TSX sources
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill that /#/display/badge matches DRUIDS Tag visuals

userStories.title: Restyle panels, modals and popovers to DRUIDS surfaces
userStories.description: As a designer, I want OUI Panel / Modal / Popover / Card to render flat 4px-radius surfaces on --ui-background-elevated with DRUIDS shadow levels. Edit only src/themes/v9/global_styling/variables/_panel.scss and add an override in src/themes/v9/components/_panel.scss imported from the components index.
acceptanceCriteria: $ouiPanelBackgroundColorModifiers.plain uses var(--ui-background-elevated); modal/popover use $ouiShadow2 / $ouiShadow4 respectively (matching DRUIDS guidance)
No changes to panel/modal/popover TSX sources
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill that /#/layout/panel and /#/layout/modal match DRUIDS radii and shadows

userStories.title: Restyle links and tabs to DRUIDS interaction blue
userStories.description: As a designer, I want OUI Link and Tabs to use DRUIDS interaction primary blue and hover contrast. Edit only src/themes/v9/components/_link.scss and add src/themes/v9/components/_tabs.scss (imported from the components index).
acceptanceCriteria: ouiLink color = $ouiColorPrimary; hover color = #0953bf (--ui-interaction-primary-contrast); visited color unchanged
Text decoration on hover only (matching DRUIDS link behavior)
OuiTab underline uses 2px solid $ouiColorPrimary; inactive tab color uses $ouiTextSubduedColor
No changes to Link/Tabs TSX sources
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill on /#/navigation/link and /#/navigation/tabs

userStories.title: Restyle callouts and toasts to DRUIDS soft statuses
userStories.description: As a designer, I want OuiCallOut and OuiToast to use DRUIDS soft status backgrounds with matching contrast text. Edit only src/themes/v9/components/_call_out.scss and _toast.scss.
acceptanceCriteria: Info callout bg derives from #eaf6fc (--ui-interaction-secondary); danger bg from rgba(235,54,75,0.1); warning bg from rgba(249,157,2,0.15); success bg from rgba(65,196,100,0.15)
Border radius = 4px; left border (if any) = 2px in the matching primary color
Text uses the -contrast variant of the matching status color so copy passes AA
Toast uses --ui-background-shade (#464b59) with knockout text per DRUIDS shade scaffolding
No changes to callout/toast TSX sources
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill on /#/display/callout and /#/display/toast

userStories.title: Restyle tables and data grid to DRUIDS
userStories.description: As a designer, I want OuiBasicTable and OuiDataGrid to render DRUIDS-style rows: 28px-ish row height, 1px #e2e5ed borders, subtle zebra, hover bg #f9fafb. Edit only src/themes/v9/components/_data_grid.scss and add src/themes/v9/components/_table.scss (imported from the components index).
acceptanceCriteria: Header bg = $ouiPageBackgroundColor (#f9fafb), header text uses $ouiTextSubduedColor uppercase/tracking matching DRUIDS TableHeaderCell
No changes to table/datagrid TSX sources
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill on /#/tabular-content/tables and /#/tabular-content/data-grid

userStories.title: Restyle code blocks to DRUIDS code palette
userStories.description: As a designer, I want OuiCode and OuiCodeBlock to use DRUIDS Roboto Mono and the --ui-code-* palette. Edit only src/themes/v9/global_styling/variables/_colors.scss (code tokens) and add src/themes/v9/components/_code.scss (imported from the components index).
acceptanceCriteria: $ouiCodeBlockColor, $ouiCodeBlockKeywordColor, $ouiCodeBlockStringColor, $ouiCodeBlockNumberColor and $ouiCodeBlockCommentColor remapped to DRUIDS code-text/code-keyword/code-string/code-boolean/code-comment (see color page for exact values)
No changes to code TSX sources
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill on /#/editors-syntax/code and /#/editors-syntax/code-block

userStories.title: Mirror all color/border/shadow overrides in v9 dark theme
userStories.description: As a designer, I want the v9 dark theme to follow DRUIDS dark scaffolding so dark mode tracks the new tokens. Edit only src/themes/v9/v9_colors_dark.scss (and css_variables/_elevation.scss if needed for dark :root overrides).
acceptanceCriteria: $ouiShadowOpacity increased to 0.8 for dark (DRUIDS: shadows are 80% in dark)
--ui-background-elevated set to #272626 and --ui-border-elevated to #3b393d via dark override of _elevation.scss
